# ElasticSpikingTransformer

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spiking neural network architecture that dynamically adjusts its computational depth or width based on input complexity for gesture recognition tasks. Enables energy-efficient inference in neuromorphic systems by allocating compute only when needed, critical for edge gesture understanding.
